ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Touch Padel uses the camera only when you take a profile photo or a work photo.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Touch Padel uses your photos only when you choose a profile photo or attach a work photo.
ios.NSMotionUsageDescription: Touch Padel uses your phone's motion only to move your points card as you tilt the phone. It never counts steps or tracks activity.
